description: DUYA retrievable memory (RAG) UserPromptSubmit hook — runs scripts/memory-search.mjs SYNCHRONOUSLY on every user prompt (plan 430+ line-windowed snippet). Retrieval is keyword-only or vector cos over a tiny SQLite index (bge-m3 / ollama), typically well under 500 ms, and the agent blocks the first turn for that span so the model sees the retrieved memory on the SAME turn as the user's prompt. The output `### 相关记忆` block carries the title + path + line-windowed snippet of each top-N hit (the matched line plus a few lines above and below — `FORMAT_TOP_HIT_LINES` for the top hit, `FORMAT_OTHER_HIT_LINES` for the rest, `FORMAT_TOTAL_CHARS` ceiling). The full body is no longer injected because a matched term deep in a doc otherwise pulls the entire doc into context; the path stays visible so the model can `read` the full file on demand. EDIT args[0] below to match the duya install location on this machine (dev repo path or packaged resources path — see the memory-search skill for how to resolve it).
